title: Abhishek fireworks, Malinga spell sink Chennai
byline: Sri Lankan pacer Eshan Malinga’s tight spell of 3-29 and a trademark blistering half-century by Abhishek Sharma helped Sunrisers Hyderabad down Chennai Super Kings by 10 runs on Saturday in the Indian Premier League.

title: Seven injured in clash at Anamaduwa New Year festival
byline: At least seven individuals were hospitalized following a violent altercation that erupted during a New Year (Avurudu) festival in the Karambawe area of Anamaduwa yesterday (18). According to the police, the injured persons were rushed to the Anamaduwa Base Hospital for immediate medical treatment.

title: Strait of Hormuz closed again, Iran says, as ships attacked
byline: Iran says it is closing the Strait of Hormuz again to commercial vessels and that any ship that approaches it will be targeted.

title: Trump says UFO review uncovered ’interesting’ documents
byline: President Donald Trump said on Friday that his administration’s review of UFO-related ​material uncovered a number of “interesting” documents, adding that an ‌initial tranche of records is expected to be released soon.

title: Indian Vice-President arrives on two-day official visit
byline: The Vice-President of India, C. P. Radhakrishnan, arrived in Sri Lanka this morning,  commencing a two-day official visit.

title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles again, flexing muscle amid Iran war
byline: North ‌Korea fired ballistic missiles into the sea on Sunday, accelerating its missile launches amid Iran war tensions and talk of possible meetings with the U.S. and South Korea.

title: Bangladeshi businessman nabbed at BIA with Rs. 5.1 mn cigarette haul
byline: A foreign passenger who attempted to smuggle a stock of foreign-made cigarettes worth Rs. 5.1 million into the country was arrested by Airport Customs officers at the Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) this morning (19).

title: Bangladesh raises fuel prices as Iran war drives up costs
byline: Bangladesh has raised retail fuel prices by 10% to 15%, citing a sharp surge in global crude ​oil prices and tightening supplies caused by the ongoing ‌Middle East conflict, the energy ministry said late on Saturday.

title: SLPP’s Cassilingam urges India–Sri Lanka talks to focus on refugees, fishermen, connectivity
byline: Jaffna District Organizer of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna, Geethanath Cassilingam, has called on Sri Lanka and India to use the upcoming visit of the Indian Vice President to address long-standing humanitarian and livelihood issues affecting communities on both sides of the Palk Strait.

title: Iranian President insists on country’s nuclear rights
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump ​has no justification ‌to deprive Iran of its nuclear ​rights, the ​Iranian Student News Agency ⁠quoted Iranian President ​Masoud Pezeshkian as ​saying on Sunday, as Washington and Tehran ​continue to face ​disagreements over nuclear issues.

title: NOCSL Election Committee rejects objections against Jaswar Umar
byline: The three-member Election Committee of the National Olympic Committee of Sri Lanka (NOCSL) has decided to reject all three objections submitted against 2026–2030 presidential candidate Jaswar Umar. A total of 34 candidates have submitted nominations for 11 key positions within the NOCSL, with five candidates, including Umar, contesting for the post of President.

title: Titanic life jacket sells for £670,000 at auction
byline: A life jacket worn by a Titanic survivor has been sold at auction to a collector for £670,000.

title: Sri Lanka Air Force deployed for expressway rescue operations
byline: The Sri Lanka Air Force has been deployed to assist in rescue operations along the country’s expressway network, according to Air Force Media Spokesperson Group Captain Nalin Wewakumbura.

title: Pakistan tightens security in Islamabad ahead of US-Iran talks
byline: Security in Pakistan’s capital Islamabad was stepped up visibly on Sunday ahead of peace talks between the United States and Iran in the coming days.

title: ‘Last chance’ for Iran to make a peace deal, warns Trump
byline: The US president Donald Trump has told Fox News this is the “last chance” for Iran to agree to a peace deal.

title: Indian Vice President meets Sri Lankan leaders to deepen bilateral ties
byline: India’s Vice President, C. P. Radhakrishnan, met Sri Lankan President Anura Kumara Dissanayake at the Presidential Secretariat in Colombo today, with both sides holding discussions aimed at further strengthening India–Sri Lanka relations.

title: US negotiators to return to Pakistan for Iran talks as Trump makes threats if no deal
byline: US president Donald Trump has said his special envoy Steve Witkoff is travelling to Pakistan for talks with Iran on Monday.

title: No Iranian negotiating team being sent to Pakistan yet: Report
byline: There ⁠is currently no ⁠decision by Iran ⁠to send a negotiating delegation ‌to Pakistan “as long as there is a naval ⁠blockade”, Iran’s Tasnim ⁠News Agency ⁠reports.

title: SL name youthful squad for first NZ match
byline: Sri Lanka has been forced to field a secondstring XV for the opening Test against the New Zealand Under85kg side on April 25, as a long domestic season, injuries, and player unavailability due to Sevens have impacted squad selection.
